newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-LEVERKUSEN STEP UP TITLE CAMPAIGN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEVERKUSEN STEP UP TITLE CAMPAIGN.

text.p: Bayer Leverkusen stepped up their title campaign with a 2-1 victory over VfB Stuttgart on Sunday to cut Bayern Munich's lead at the top of the German league to three points.
Leverkusen jumped ahead of champions Borussia Dortmund to go into second place with six matches left in the Bundesliga. Bayern and Dortmund played out a 1-1 draw on Saturday.
Stuttgart's fight for the title was thwarted by goals from Leverkusen's midfielder Paulo Sergio in the 42nd minute and striker Ulf Kirsten in the 68th minute.
Stuttgart defender Thomas Berthold pulled one back with 15 minutes to go.
"We wasted good opportunities. After halftime we lost the thread of the game. But in the end we gave it all we had," Stuttgart coach Joachim Loew said.
